body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 13:08Z, my own miss). Before sending a gate GO, wait for the other side's MAILED END of every warm series it announced. A single passed run in /api/test-runs does not end a series. I sent S1's gate GO at 13:07Z after seeing 8581's third run pass, but the series had a fourth run (test-548b54aa, which ended 13:07:55Z). It was harmless only because S1 was then withdrawn before launch (its own clippy warning). Engram::Fable disclosed it in #3579.
